admission.justification: The recorded behavioral fixture assertions guard this obligation; the proof facets distinguish their limited fixture behavior from real-host or full-final acceptance.

applicability: One owning Manager's leaf-set start, deferred held-seat reservation, replacing held starts, and receipt-bound first-message held-seat opening (MIK-R100 rule 2 as revised by D1045 / BUG-R58@v2).
conditions: The set request derives stable per-role seat request identities and retries partial creation without a fourth agent.

Optional Reviewer work opens Reviewer on the host immediately; ordinary held preparation reserves Reviewer and Curator on disk with status=held, hostAgentExists=false, execution={}, handover on disk, and stored replayRequest without calling host agent-create.

A replacing held start archives a live predecessor immediately and checks finish_replacing_predecessor before reserving the new seat; any archive or settlement-write failure publishes status=unknown with pendingArchiveAgentId debt and reserves nothing.

Unretired, non-closing deferred held seats are treated as live occupants by seat readers and occupancy reconciliation without host reads, and open on first role_message using the stored replayRequest verbatim.
One unarchived agent holds a leaf seat, including while closed or reserved; explicit authorized replacement and ambiguous-resolver refusal retain that rule.
exclusions: A held manual single-role launcher start outside deferred held-seat preparation.
Taskless role capacity or a broadened role may-start table.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_role_start_set.py and held-message suites pass on 3c2285d1; sealed round-1 closure carried through rounds 2-6 verdicts

statement: One role_start_set call starts the leaf's Worker open on the host immediately while reserving Reviewer and Curator on disk as deferred held seats (status held, hostAgentExists false, execution {}, pre-minted agentId, handover on disk, and stored replayRequest with zero host calls); repeat sends reconcile identical seat identities; replacing a live predecessor archives and settles it before reserving the new seat (keeping pendingArchiveAgentId debt under status unknown and reserving nothing if archive or settlement write fails); every seat reader keeps unretired, non-closing deferred held seats live without host reads; the first role_message creates and opens the addressed held seat with its stored replayRequest verbatim and delivers pre-open held messages in one turn; and one-seat occupancy with resolver refusal holds.
title: Leaf-set start defers held seat creation until first message
